snippet.title: Lou's Lagoon | Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Lou's Lagoon Demo is out now on Steam!

Download and play the Demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499130/Lous_Lagoon_Demo/

Take flight in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After a devastating storm, gather materials with your Swirler, and help the locals rebuild. Can you uncover the truth behind Uncle Lou’s disappearance? 

What's in the Lou's Lagoon demo?
🌴Explore Lou's Island. Meet the locals and help fix up the storm-damaged community hub.
🛠️Collect, craft, restore. Harness the vacuum power of the Swirler to gather scrap, native plants, and more.
🛫Pilot your own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 
🎨Character customization. Make your avatar uniquely yours.
🎁A special reward awaits those who play to the very end.

Soaring onto PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S this year!

Wishlist now: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2100020/Lous_Lagoon/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10012807
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9ndpvffzf6sk

Follow us on social media for more information:
Discord: https://www.discord.gg/tinyroar
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/louslagoon_game/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@louslagoon_game
